title: Spiriti! Napoli '97
name: spiriti-napoli97
summary: Naples, 1997: clean the slimed lungomare, trap six spirits, face the guardian of Villa Doria d'Angri and a giant Pulcinella.
description: An unofficial paranormal arcade tribute set in Naples in 1997. Drive the Fiat 500 along the lungomare, hoovering slime off the road while spirits fly over and try to slime the car. Trap a spirit in front of six landmarks, from the Gesu Nuovo to the Reggia di Capodimonte. Banish the guardian of Villa Doria d'Angri with the proton pack, hear it ask for the form of the destructor, then race to Piazza del Plebiscito with a giant trap on the roof and catch an evil giant Pulcinella. Palette-indexed art with exact colours on the ESP32-C6, palette effects, and an original ten-track SID-like soundtrack that follows the action, with stereo-panned effects.
controls: Map: LEFT/RIGHT choose, A dispatch. Drive: UP/DOWN lanes, RIGHT/LEFT gas/brake. Capture: hold A for the beam, LEFT/RIGHT move, B give up; in the piazza B opens the trap. SELECT high scores.
content_notice: Unofficial tribute, not affiliated with the Ghostbusters rights holders; no franchise logo, soundtrack, dialogue or art is included.
